column1: # PostgreSQL 17.11 (postgres:17-alpine) answers for TestArcCPConstantProbeEveryArm's generated cells over cp_t / cp_u:
# name<TAB>rows=N <sorted rows> | ERR <SQLSTATE> <message>. Regenerate: CP_GEN=<path> dumps name<TAB>sql; each is run once. Booleans render as brRender does (true/false; psql prints t/f).
